cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied your big label for our nut biscuits. Pick the best ones; your name's on the plate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My label says NUTS, not my name. It warns people with allergies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, information first. Write your name under it so the committee knows whose judgment to trust.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put the plate by the door, then. People can see the warning before taking one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your chair there too. Everyone who tries one can tell you personally what they think.
